scripts.build: npm run lint && npm run typecheck:tests && npm run test && npm run clean-build && npm run compile && npm run copy-templates
scripts.check:fix: npm install && npm audit fix && npm run format && npm run lint:fix && npm run build && npm run check:start
scripts.copy-templates: npx shx cp -R ./src/templates ./build/templates && npx shx cp -R ./src/config ./build/config
scripts.reinit: node scripts/rm.mjs package-lock.json node_modules && npm i && npm run build

//overrides.semver@*: Force latest semver 7.x across all sub-deps; gluegun@5.2.2 pins semver@7.7.0 which is stale - remove once gluegun updates its dep.
//overrides.brace-expansion@<1.1.21: Five DoS advisories, all patched in the 1.x line by 1.1.21: exponential-time expansion of consecutive non-expanding {} groups (GHSA-3jxr-9vmj-r5cp, high, fixed 1.1.16), unbounded expansion length causing an OOM crash (GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg, high, fixed 1.1.17), uncontrolled recursion in parseCommaParts (GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p, high, fixed 1.1.19), uncontrolled recursion on nested brace groups (GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, high, fixed 1.1.20) and quadratic-time `{a},b}` rewrite (GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr, medium, fixed 1.1.21). Raised from 1.1.18 on 2026-10-03: 1.1.18 was still open to the last three. Transitive via dotgitignore/eslint/fs-jetpack/glob/test-exclude/ts-morph > minimatch. Latent today: the minimatch raises below leave no 1.x install in the tree (only brace-expansion 5.0.12), so this key catches a future minimatch 3.x consumer. One bounded key per affected major so each can only raise a vulnerable version, never cap a patched one - remove once minimatch requests the patched ranges.
//overrides.brace-expansion@>=2.0.0 <2.1.7: Same five advisories, 2.x line (fixed 2.1.2 / 2.1.3 / 2.1.5 / 2.1.6 / 2.1.7). Raised from 2.1.4 on 2026-10-03. Latent today, like the 1.x key.
//overrides.brace-expansion@>=5.0.0 <5.0.12: Same advisories, 5.x line, plus three newer DoS advisories fixed only in 5.0.10-5.0.12 (GHSA-6j4f-fj2g-mc7p, GHSA-qhr7-859c-m2p7, GHSA-q2hr-2g5m-vwhr; all high). Reaches production via gluegun > fs-jetpack > minimatch. Floored at >=5.0.0 so a future 3.x/4.x dependency is not silently forced across two majors.
//overrides.//minimatch-note: Why the minimatch raises exist: when they were added, brace-expansion 1.x and 2.x were END OF LINE for GHSA-mh99-v99m-4gvg (advisory range <=5.0.7 across ALL majors, patched only 5.0.8+), so the only fix was to raise each CONSUMER off minimatch 3.x/5.x/9.x. That premise no longer holds: upstream has since backported every fix (GHSA-mh99 now reads <1.1.17 / >=2.0.0 <2.1.3, and 1.1.21 / 2.1.7 patch all five current advisories). Verified 2026-10-03 with fresh lockfile resolves: without `minimatch@>=4 <10` and `fs-jetpack > minimatch@<10` npm audit is still clean, the tree only gains minimatch 3.1.5 + 5.1.9 and brace-expansion 1.1.21 + 2.1.7 (7 packages). So both are now a DEDUPE measure (one minimatch 10.2.6, one brace-expansion 5.0.12), not a security fix - dropping them is a judgment call, it reopens no advisory. Forcing brace-expansion 5.x globally is still NOT an option: 5.x is ESM/tshy and exports an object ({ expand, ... }) while 1.x/2.x export the function itself, so minimatch 3.x/5.x would die on `expand is not a function`. Each scoped entry was verified against the consumer's actual call site before being added. The eslint / @eslint/eslintrc / @eslint/config-array entries were REMOVED in 1.42.0: eslint 10 requests minimatch ^10.2.5 itself, config-array ^10.2.4, and eslintrc is no longer in the tree at all. Superseded 2026-11-03: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (minimatch <11.0.1, moderate, DoS via globparts amplification) is fixed only in 11.x, a rewrite without makeRe/AST/matchOne/regexp. Every consumer that can run on 11 is raised by a scoped entry; there is no global minimatch key any more, because npm 10 (CI, Node 20) rejected the lockfile a global key plus a scoped downgrade produced (Missing: glob@13.0.6 / minimatch@10.2.6), even one it had written itself. Verify any change here with npx -y npm@10.9.2 ci --dry-run AND npm ci --dry-run.
//overrides.minimatch: scoped upgrades to 11.0.8: GHSA-g3hv-75wg-m249 (fixed 11.0.1). Target raised 11.0.4 -> 11.0.7 on 2026-11-11 and to 11.0.8 on 2026-11-12, together with the direct devDependency, so the scoped keys never pin below the newest 11.x (glob 14 itself requests ^11.0.5). @eslint/config-array, @typescript-eslint/typescript-estree and eslint (lint), @ts-morph/common (PRODUCTION: the ts-morph conversions) request ^10 and use only new Minimatch(...).match/negate/set and minimatch(), all present in 11. filelist (PRODUCTION-reachable: gluegun > ejs > jake > filelist) requests ^5.0.1 and calls only the static minimatch.match(list, pattern, opts), also present in 11 (re-checked 2026-11-04: filelist 1.0.6 resolves 11.0.4, match(['a.js','b.ts','c.js'], '*.js') returns ['a.js','c.js']). Verified 2026-11-03: lint, the full test suite, compile and check:start green, npm audit clean. eslint-plugin-import-x, the one consumer that imports makeRe (gone in 11), left the tree with @lenne.tech/eslint-config-ts (see eslint.config.mjs). Drop each line once that consumer requests minimatch >=11.0.1.
//overrides.fs-jetpack > minimatch@<11.0.1: Same advisory, PRODUCTION-reachable (gluegun > fs-jetpack, which requests ^3.0.2). lib/utils/matcher.js uses only new Minimatch(pattern, { matchBase, nocomment, nocase, dot }), .negate and .match(), all present in 11. Not fixable by upgrading: gluegun@5.2.2 is the latest release and pins fs-jetpack 4.3.1.
//overrides.glob@<8 > minimatch: glob 7 (fs-jetpack > rimraf 2 > glob 7, PRODUCTION) requests minimatch ^3.1.1. npm 11 reaches it through the fs-jetpack key, npm 10 does not once rimraf 2 is hoisted, so the rule is explicit. Never exercised: fs-jetpack calls rimraf with disableGlob: true. glob 7 itself is outside GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (>=9).
//overrides.glob: scoped upgrades to 14.0.4: GHSA-3g3m-2fjr-6pw4 (glob 9.0.0-14.0.1, moderate, AbortSignal cancellation bypass, fixed 14.0.2). glob is a direct PRODUCTION dependency of this CLI (globSync in server.ts, api-mode.ts, strip-vendor-schema-augmentation.ts, nuxt-base-components.ts), raised to 14.0.3, whose exports match 13, and to 14.0.4 on 2026-11-11. Its former dev-only consumers (jest, rimraf 6, test-exclude) left with jest and rimraf on 2026-11-03, so no scoped glob entry is needed any more.
